items.name: Cavity_mediated_interaction_TFM
items.description: Quantum Monte Carlo study of a 1D Bose gas with cavity-mediated long-range interactions. Includes imaginary time evolution for trial wavefunctions, spline-based interpolation, VMC and DMC simulations, structure factor analysis, and superfluid fraction via the Leggett bound. Code in Python and Julia.
